stem: Northgate Retail wants one of its module blocks held to the 2.x release line with a `version` constraint. Which `source` value can carry that constraint?
rationale: The `version` argument applies only when the source is a module listed in a registry, and the three-part `NAMESPACE/NAME/PROVIDER` address is a registry address. A local path is not covered because local modules always share the version of their caller. A Git source is pinned with the `ref` query parameter instead, and an archive in an S3 bucket is not a registry module, so neither takes a version constraint.
